name: Lima Art Museum
scope: The standing Palacio de la Exposición in Lima housing the Museo de Arte de Lima, with two projecting pavilions, restored neorenaissance elevations and central courtyard.
era: Restored 2022 state of the exterior of the 1870–1871 exhibition palace.

originalReview.notes: The Bureau of Public Roads 34782 archival view shows the projecting Paseo Colón pavilion, three tall ground-floor entrance arches, side corner, windows with paired lancets under common round heads, balustrade and prominent cornices and crest.

review.method: Qualla-first search, original NARA JPEG and native metadata, museum restoration controls and OSM building outline
review.notes: Reviewed the published Qualla gallery first. Its cleared images depict art and archaeological objects or other locations. The Department of Commerce archive JPEG is the architectural reference. The current museum restoration report supplies written controls for retained facade elements. The early Courret candidates are tracked as unselected.
